theme.description: Desktop-first dense ERP layout tailored for TechHind Pvt Ltd Indian SaaS accounting, compliant with Indian GST rules, fiscal year (1 Apr - 31 Mar), and high-contrast precision tokens.

typography.font_family_body: IBM Plex Sans, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif

scale.h1: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
scale.h2: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100
scale.caption: text-xs font-medium text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400
scale.badge: text-[11px] font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider px-2 py-0.5 rounded

typography.guidelines: Never use Inter for headings. Use IBM Plex Mono / JetBrains Mono for GST numbers (GSTIN), invoice numbers (TH/2025-26/0042), HSN/SAC codes, and INR amounts. All INR currency must display standard Indian number groupings (e.g. ₹12,45,500.00).

colors.rules: High contrast is critical for financial accuracy. Never use pure transparent backgrounds on floating dropdowns, popovers, or modal sheets. Buttons should have distinct active and hover states.

workspace_structure.layout_type: Desktop-first Left-nav Workspace with Top Contextual Command Bar
workspace_structure.sidebar_width: w-64 shrink-0 bg-slate-900 text-slate-200 border-r border-slate-800
workspace_structure.header_height: h-14 bg-white/95 dark:bg-slate-900/95 backdrop-blur border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 px-6 sticky top-0 z-40
workspace_structure.sub_strip_height: h-11 bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-800/80 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700/60 px-6 flex items-center justify-between

action_strips.nearby_renewals: Persistent high-visibility strip showing Overdue (Red), 7 Days (Amber), 15 Days (Blue), 30 Days renewals count with 1-click filter
action_strips.operational_queue: Persistent counter strip showing: Invoices Pending Approval, Unallocated Receipts, Unapproved Expense Vouchers, Period Close Checklist

layout_and_grids.density_mode: Compact High-Density (Mode B: High Density Grid)

table_specifications.header_style: bg-slate-100 dark:bg-slate-800/90 text-slate-700 dark:text-slate-300 font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-[11px] border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 sticky top-0 z-10
table_specifications.borders: border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-700 rounded-lg overflow-hidden shadow-xs
table_specifications.actions: Inline actions dropdown or quick action icons (Edit, View PDF, Approve, Record Payment, Download CSV)

rules: Same State Customer (POS = 29): Apply CGST 9% + SGST 9% (for 18% slab) or matching split
Inter-State Customer (POS != 29): Apply IGST 18% (single tax line)
SEZ / Export Customer: Zero Rated with LUT or IGST with refund flag
Invoice Round-off: Automatic Indian currency round-off to nearest integer (e.g. +₹0.32 or -₹0.48)
Numbering Series: Strict format TH/{FY}/{SEQ:4} e.g. TH/2025-26/0001
Immutability: Status transitions Draft -> Approved (Locked) -> Paid / Partial. Once Approved, fields are immutable. Corrections only via Credit/Debit Notes.

header.registered_office: Level 6, TechHind Tower, Outer Ring Road, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560103

sections: Header with TechHind brand styling and GSTIN badge
Invoice Metadata: Invoice No, Invoice Date, Due Date, Place of Supply (State & Code), Reverse Charge (Y/N)
Billed To vs Shipped To: Customer Legal Name, Trade Name, GSTIN, Full Address, State & Code
Itemized Table: Sl No, Description of Service/SaaS Plan, HSN/SAC Code, Qty, Unit, Rate, Discount, Taxable Value, GST Rate, CGST, SGST/IGST, Total (INR)
Tax Summary Table: Detailed HSN/SAC-wise breakup with taxable amount and split tax amounts
Total Calculations: Sub-Total, Total Tax, Round Off (+/-), Total Invoice Value in Words (e.g., 'Rupees Twelve Lakh Forty-Five Thousand Only')
Bank Details for NEFT/RTGS: Bank Name, Account Name, Account Number, IFSC Code, Branch, UPI ID
Authorized Signatory box with Digital Stamp placeholder and Terms & Conditions

visual_enhancers.texture: Clean engineered paper feel with micro 1px border lines and slate slate-50/slate-100 alternating zebra rows on dense ledgers.
visual_enhancers.badges: Structured pill and square tags for status (Draft, Pending Approval, Approved/Locked, Partially Paid, Paid, Overdue, Cancelled).
visual_enhancers.charts: Recharts with crisp dual-tone fills (TechHind Blue #0F284E and Emerald Green #10B981), minimal grid lines, and interactive tooltip formatting with ₹ symbol.

instructions_to_main_agent.role_management: Implement 4 distinct RBAC personas: Admin (full access), Accountant (create/approve invoices, journals, payments, period close), Ops (create draft invoices, manage customer subscriptions & renewals), Viewer (strictly read-only on all financial data, restricted from settings). Provide a quick role-switcher in the top header for instant demo/testing.
instructions_to_main_agent.totp_2fa_mock: Include an optional TOTP 2FA flow on login/security settings with standard 6-digit verification code mockup and backup codes generator.
instructions_to_main_agent.audit_trail_trigger: Every critical action (Invoice Created, Invoice Approved, Payment Recorded, Expense Approved, Period Closed, Master Updated) MUST log an entry with Timestamp, User, Role, Action Type, Entity ID, and Diff Summary.
instructions_to_main_agent.data_testids: All buttons, tabs, inputs, filters, action triggers, and summary stat cards MUST include clear data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='approve-invoice-btn', data-testid='kpi-mrr-card', data-testid='nearby-renewals-strip').
instructions_to_main_agent.file_structure: Ensure all files are created as modern React .js/.jsx components with Tailwind CSS and Radix UI / lucide-react.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Never render plain boring cards or generic empty layouts. Build rich mock datasets representing an authentic Indian SaaS company (e.g. clients like Swiggy, Razorpay, Zepto, Zerodha, InfoEdge, Flipkart, Zoho) with real Indian GSTIN numbers, state codes (29-KA, 27-MH, 07-DL, 33-TN), HSN 998313 / 998314 for SaaS software, 18% GST.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.navigation_discipline: Always display the left-nav workspace with collapsible sections, clear active highlighting, and badged counts on action strips.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.modal_and_sheets: Use solid backgrounds with crisp borders for all dialogs and drawer sheets. Never use transparent backgrounds.
